This senior-level role focuses on enterprise IT operations, network infrastructure, service reliability, and technical support within a complex global environment. You’ll help design, coordinate, administer, and continuously improve network systems while resolving operational issues across critical infrastructure. The position combines hands-on technical troubleshooting with service management, stakeholder coordination, security, and operational excellence. You’ll work closely with IT operations teams, business stakeholders, technicians, and onsite counterparts to deliver reliable and high-quality services. A strong emphasis is placed on incident, problem, change, and service-level management, as well as proactive identification and resolution of operational risks. You’ll also contribute to corporate initiatives, technical improvements, mentoring, and the adoption of industry best practices across the wider team. With a hybrid working model and limited travel, this is an opportunity to take ownership of enterprise network operations while influencing service quality across a large-scale technology environment. Third-line support: Work with team leaders, managers, and technicians to provide 3rd Line Network support, engineering assistance, problem diagnosis, and resolution across enterprise environments. Incident and problem management: Take ownership of issues affecting IT services and operations, coordinating resolution of major incidents, priority issues, and recurring problems through to completion. Remote troubleshooting: Diagnose network and infrastructure issues through calls and other remote support channels, providing clear repair instructions and technical guidance while also supporting issues in person when required. Network security: Monitor network access for connectivity problems, bottlenecks, and security threats, and configure and maintain appropriate security devices and controls. Service management: Maintain a strong focus on call, incident, problem, change, and service-level management, ensuring agreed service standards and performance expectations are consistently achieved. Customer collaboration: Analyse customer needs, work through problems, agree appropriate solutions, and coordinate effectively with onsite counterparts and other IT support teams. Metrics and reporting: Implement appropriate metrics, reporting, and Service Level Management practices to measure performance at departmental and individual levels. Operational ownership: Maintain accountability for task planning, prioritisation, execution, administration, meetings, and delivery against agreed timelines. Quality and standards: Maintain departmental standards and quality initiatives while ensuring operational processes and services consistently meet required expectations. Stakeholder relationships: Build strong working relationships with internal and external customers, business units, IT colleagues, and technology partners across different functions and geographic locations. Mentoring and people development: Encourage collaboration and high-performing behaviours within the team while providing direction, mentoring, and support to direct and indirect colleagues. Technical development: Keep personal technical knowledge and training current in line with evolving IT infrastructure, emerging technologies, and changing operational requirements. Continuous improvement: Participate in corporate initiatives and implement strategies within areas of responsibility to improve customer satisfaction, service quality, and departmental performance. Compliance and risk: Proactively enforce applicable regulatory requirements and enterprise standards, ensuring responsible data and processes remain compliant and deliver the intended outcomes. Networking collaboration: Influence and collaborate across national and functional boundaries to strengthen networking services and achieve shared operational objectives.
